formulas.cohen_kappa: p_o = (#items with label_A == label_B)/n; p_e = sum_k (n_Ak/n)(n_Bk/n) over the label set; kappa = (p_o - p_e)/(1 - p_e). Label sets: entailment {supported, overstated, not_supported, unintelligible}; relevance {relevant, partial, not_relevant}.
formulas.final_label: label = pass_a label if pass_a == pass_b else the adjudicated label (for shipped pinned_rematch the matched-run re-adjudication replaces the pinned run's adjudication).
formulas.rates: support rate = #supported / #returned claims in the subset; responsiveness = #relevant / #returned claims; partial and not_relevant likewise.
formulas.cluster_bootstrap: Percentile cluster bootstrap: the resampling unit is the question. For B=5000 resamples (random.Random(0), questions drawn with replacement, k = number of questions in the group), the statistic is recomputed as a RATIO OF SUMS over the drawn questions (all claims of a drawn question move together). CI95 = [2.5th, 97.5th] percentile of the B draws (numpy.percentile, linear interpolation). Paired statistics draw the SAME questions for both arms. SE = sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of the B draws.
formulas.retention: retention = sum_q claims_displayed(q) / sum_q claims_total(q) over the questions in the group (ratio of sums); max/min ratio = highest type retention / lowest type retention.
formulas.zero_claim: proportion = #questions with claims_displayed == 0 / #questions; paired difference = proportion(URL-first) - proportion(shipped) on the same drawn questions.
formulas.task5: both-set = questions with >=1 returned claim in BOTH arms. Pooled difference = (sum positives_UF / sum n_UF) - (sum positives_shipped / sum n_shipped) over the drawn questions; mean per-question difference = mean_q [positives_UF(q)/n_UF(q) - positives_shipped(q)/n_shipped(q)]. Both use the paired cluster bootstrap (same drawn questions in both arms).

notes: metadata.answer_mode is 'standard' for all 134 records in both arms, so it cannot split standard vs deep. The paper's standard/deep profile is metadata.pipeline.retrieval_profile (67/67, identical per question in both arms); that field is used wherever 'answer_mode' was requested, and the literal answer_mode split is reported beside it.
